1.consolidated_definition: Fruto del algarrobo, en forma de vaina gruesa y dura, de color marrón al madurar y con varias semillas cubiertas de una pulpa polvosa y de color amarillento. FabaceaeHymenaea courbaril.
1.en_consolidated_definition: The fruit of the algarrobo tree, in the form of a thick and hard pod, brown in color when mature and containing several seeds covered with a powdery pulp of yellowish hue. Fabaceae Hymenaea courbaril.
